reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was "Every batch lab-tested" with a QR code, and anyone can print that; I look for NSF or USP on the box and there is none. A brand with zero reviews at $1 a day is a lot to ask when I already have a Subscribe & Save magnesium I don't think about.
objection: No NSF or USP mark and no reviews, so I'm taking the brand's word that the QR report is real. At $29.99 for 30 servings it is also pricier per serving than the magnesium I already auto-ship.
would_change_my_mind: NSF Certified or USP Verified on the box, plus a few hundred real reviews, and a price closer to $20 for the month.
